employment_hours_earnings: Holds time-series observations of employment/hours/earnings by series_id; grain = one row per series_id × year × period (columns: series_id, year, period, date); measures/keys = value, footnote_codes, series_title.
employment_hours_earnings_series: Holds metadata for employment/hours/earnings series; grain = one row per series_id; measures/keys = series_id, supersector_code, industry_code, data_type_code, seasonal, series_title, footnote_codes, begin_year, begin_period, end_year, end_period.
wm: Holds time-series observations (wage/misc) by series_id; grain = one row per series_id × year × period (columns: series_id, year, period, date); measures/keys = value, footnote_codes, series_title.
unemployment_cps: Holds CPS unemployment time-series observations by series_id; grain = one row per series_id × year × period (columns: series_id, year, period, date); measures/keys = value, footnote_codes, series_title.
cpi_u: Holds CPI-U time-series observations by series_id and item/area; grain = one row per series_id × year × period (columns: series_id, year, period, date) representing an area_code × item_code observation; measures/keys = value, footnote_codes, survey_abbreviation, seasonal_code, periodicity_code, area_code, area_name, item_code, item_name.
c_cpi_u: Holds CPI-U (alternative/consumer) time-series observations by series_id and item/area; grain = one row per series_id × year × period (columns: series_id, year, period, date) representing an area_code × item_code observation; measures/keys = value, footnote_codes, survey_abbreviation, seasonal_code, periodicity_code, area_code, area_name, item_code, item_name.
unemployment_cps_series: Holds metadata for CPS unemployment series with many demographic/characteristic codes; grain = one row per series_id; measures/keys = series_id, lfst_code, periodicity_code, series_title, absn_code, activity_code, ages_code, class_code, duration_code, education_code, entr_code, expr_code, hheader_code, hour_code, indy_code, jdes_code, look_code, mari_code, mjhs_code, occupation_code, orig_code, pcts_code, race_code, rjnw_code, rnlf_code, rwns_code, seek_code, sexs_code, tdat_code, vets_code, wkst_code, born_code, chld_code, disa_code, seasonal, footnote_codes, begin_year, begin_period, end_year, end_period.
wm_series: Holds metadata for wm series (wage/metrics) by series_id with classification codes; grain = one row per series_id; measures/keys = series_id, seasonal, area_code, ownership_code, estimate_code, industry_code, occupation_code, subcell_code, datatype_code, level_code, series_title, footnote_codes, begin_year, begin_period, end_year, end_period.
cpsaat18: Holds cross-sectional employment composition by industry/sector for a year; grain = one row per year × sector × subsector × industry_group × industry (columns: year, sector, subsector, industry_group, industry); measures/keys = total_employed_in_thousands, percent_women, percent_white, percent_black_or_african_american, percent_asian, percent_hispanic_or_latino.
2007_q3: Holds quarterly industry-level location and wage/employment indicators for geographic areas for 2007 Q3; grain = one row per area (columns: geoid, area_fips); measures/keys = many industry-specific metrics such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* locality quotients and equivalents, plus similar fields for other NAICS groups (1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23) and avg_wkly_wage_23_construction.
2001_q1: Holds quarterly industry-level location and wage/employment indicators for geographic areas for 2001 Q1; grain = one row per area (columns: geoid, area_fips); measures/keys = qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* fields, and the same set of industry-specific metrics for NAICS groups 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23, etc.
2002_q1: Holds quarterly industry-level location and wage/employment indicators for geographic areas for 2002 Q1; grain = one row per area (columns: geoid, area_fips); measures/keys = qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* fields, and the same set of industry-specific metrics for NAICS groups 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23, etc.
2009_q2: Economic/industry metrics by area (one row per geoid/area_fips) containing columns: geoid, area_fips and repeated measures per industry such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients and similar sets for industries 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23 (e.g., qtrly_estabs_1024_professional_and_business_services, avg_wkly_wage_1024_professional_and_business_services, month3_emplvl_1024_professional_and_business_services, lq_avg_wkly_wage_1024_professional_and_business_services, lq_qtrly_estabs_1024_professional_and_business_services, lq_month3_emplvl_1024_professional_and_business_services).
1996_q3: Economic/industry metrics by area (one row per geoid/area_fips) containing columns: geoid, area_fips and repeated measures per industry such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients and similar sets for industries 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23 (e.g., qtrly_estabs_1024_professional_and_business_services, avg_wkly_wage_1024_professional_and_business_services, month3_emplvl_1024_professional_and_business_services, lq_*).
2019_q1: Economic/industry metrics by area (one row per geoid/area_fips) containing columns: geoid, area_fips and repeated measures per industry such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients and similar sets for industries 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23 (e.g., qtrly_estabs_1024_professional_and_business_services, avg_wkly_wage_1024_professional_and_business_services, month3_emplvl_1024_professional_and_business_services, lq_*).
coastline: Coastline geometries (one row per name) with columns: name, coastline_geom and partition/cluster info PARTITION, CLUSTER.
csa: Combined Statistical Area geometries and attributes (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, csa_code, name, lsad_name, msa_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom, csa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
railways: Railway features (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, full_name, mtfcc_feature_class_code, railway_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
cbsa: Core-Based Statistical Area geometries and attributes (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, csa_geo_id, cbsa_fips_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, msa_indicator, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, cbsa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_counties: County adjacency listing (one row per county) with columns: county, state, county_fips_code and neighbor lists neighbors, neighbors_state, neighbors_fips_code.
counties: County geometries and attributes (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, county_name, lsad_name, lsad_code, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, csa_fips_code, cbsa_fips_code, met_div_fips_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, county_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_states: State adjacency listing (one row per state) with columns: state, state_name, state_fips_code and neighbor lists neighbors_state, neighbors_fips_code.
metropolitan_divisions: Metropolitan division geometries and attributes (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, csa_code, cbsa_code, metdiv_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, metdiv_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
states: State geometries and attributes (one row per geo_id) with columns: geo_id, region_code, division_code, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state, state_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, state_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
cnecta: Holds CT/NECTA geographic units; grain = one row per CT/NECTA geo area (geo_id); keys/measures include cnecta_fips_code, name, name_lsad, lsad, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, and geometry cnecta_geom (plus PARTITION, CLUSTER).
congress_district_116: Holds 116th Congress congressional districts; grain = one row per district (geo_id); keys/measures include state_fips_code, district_fips_code, lsad_name, lsad_code, congress_session, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal point int_point_lat/int_point_lon with int_point_geom, and district_geom (plus PARTITION, CLUSTER).
zip_codes: Holds ZIP code areas; grain = one row per ZIP code (zip_code); keys/measures include city, county, state_fips_code, state_code, state_name, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat/internal_point_lon with internal_point_geom, and zip_code_geom (plus PARTITION, CLUSTER).
nws_forecast_regions: Holds National Weather Service forecast/zone regions; grain = one row per NWS region/zone (combination of state, cwa, zone); notable fields include state, cwa, time_zone, fe_area, zone, name, state_zone, lon, lat, shortname, and shape_geometry.
urban_areas: Holds urban area geographies; grain = one row per urban area (geo_id); keys/measures include urban_area_code, name, lsad_name, area_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, type, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon/internal_point_lat with internal_point_geom, and urban_area_geom (plus PARTITION, CLUSTER).
national_outline: Holds national outline geometries; grain = one row per outline feature (aff_geo_id or geo_id); notable fields include us_outline_geom, aff_geo_id, geo_id, and name.
